Privacy

This site has no accounts, no analytics and no advertising trackers.

Saved links

Links you save in the Toolbox are stored in your browser’s local storage. Nothing is sent to a server. Clear this site’s browser data to remove them. When storage is unavailable, saved links last for the current visit only.

Import and export

Exporting creates a JSON file on your device. Importing reads that file in your browser. The file is never uploaded.

Appearance

Your light or dark theme choice is saved in your browser.

Fonts and links

Fonts and images are served with the site. External websites have their own privacy practices.

Hosting

The hosting service may process technical information needed to deliver the site, such as network requests. You can reach me on GitHub.
